messages:
sofia: Quick alert — after the driver/CUDA bump to 535.86, a subset of H100 nodes in asia-east are failing to start inference containers. Several pods are CrashLoopBackOff with PTX/JIT errors.

infra-bot: canary rollout to asia-east finished at 2026-03-18T10:02:12Z (ids: rollout-20260318-3)

leo: logs? seen anything on kernel side or is it purely ptx compile?

sofia: paste of representative error from kubelet logs:
```
W cudalib: ptxas fatal  : Value 'sm_90' is not recognized or not supported
E runtime: kernel launch failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE: invalid device image
E container: failed to initialize device kernels, exiting
```

jamie: hmm that's a PTX target mismatch during JIT. sm_90 is Hopper/SM90 — the new driver appears to be stricter about supported ptx targets. Could be the toolchain used to build the runtime/container is emitting unsupported PTX versions.

naveen: Also seeing intermittent NCCL hangs on a few multi-node training shards (all in same AZ). Allreduce timeouts ~30s after the upgrade. Might be related to kernel mismatches + missing PTX fallbacks.

leo: Which images are affected? New runtime images we built last week with CUDA 12.2?

sofia: Affected images: inference-runtime:2026-03-10 (built with nvcc targeting sm_90), plus some older builds that rely on JIT fallback. Non-affected nodes (us-west) still run 535.54 and are fine.

jamie: Immediate mitigation: 1) cordon affected nodes in asia-east 2) add nodeAffinity to avoid scheduling new inference jobs there 3) roll driver back on a small canary pool to 535.54 and validate.

sofia: Started cordoning — 8 nodes cordoned. K8s drain in progress for pods with fallback routes.

infra-bot: rollback job submitted: drivers/asia-east -> target 535.54, job id drv-rollback-342 (ETA ~ 15m)

naveen: For training jobs, pinned NCCL version bump might be required — I'll hold long all-reduce jobs until rollback validated.

leo: We should also disable auto-ptx-targeting in our build pipeline until we confirm the runtime toolchain compatibility. Jamie, can you add a quick toggle?

jamie: On it. Pushed a feature flag to ci:build that forces legacy ptx for now. Will run a new image build.

sofia: Question for cost/ops: routing production inference to us-west temporarily will spike cross-region egress and latency. Estimated cost delta ~ $2.5k/day if we shift 20% of traffic. Do we accept until driver stabilized?

leo: Approve short-term failover — SLA + user impact > cost. Keep finance in the loop.

nvidia-support-bot: Case opened with NVIDIA: #12345678. Triage assigned to partner-eng. They requested kernel logs and driverinfo from one affected node.

sofia: Dropping the requested artifacts to the case now (dmesg, /proc/driver/nvidia/version, ptxas logs).

infra-bot: alert: capacity scaling triggered — +10 dedicated instances in us-west to absorb overflow (provision-id: add-20260318-1).

jamie: Note for follow-up postmortem: capture which images explicitly contained sm_90 PTX vs relied on JIT fallback; confirm which driver release introduced tightened validation.

leo: If rollback validates, we'll schedule a staged re-rollout with a smaller canary and an opt-out label for critical training jobs.

sofia: Update: rollback to 535.54 completed on canary pool — initial smoke shows containers now start cleanly on those nodes. Still waiting on NCCL job recoveries.

naveen: NCCL jobs starting to recover, allreduce latencies back to normal on rolled-back nodes.

sofia: Going to keep asia-east partially cordoned until NVIDIA confirms whether this is a driver change or we need to rebuild images without certain PTX emissions.

leo: Thanks all. Please keep thread updated. @jamie can you paste the CI flag diff when ready? :thumbsup:

nvidia-support-bot: NVIDIA reply (10m): "Investigating strict PTX validation in 535.86 series. Recommend building images targeting 'compute_90' binary or using compatible PTX fallback. We'll post recommended driver/build pairs shortly."

sofia: Filed internal incident ticket INC-2026-032; tagging product/cust-suc for customer-facing comms.

jamie: CI flag diffs: added `--nvptx-target=compute_90:sm_90` toggle with opt-out. Pushed change in pipelines repo (ref: pipelines/commit/3f7a8).

leo: Good. Once NVIDIA confirms, we'll either re-roll drivers with careful canarying or rebuild images to emit compatible binaries.
